faqs.q: Do I need water / sewer line insurance for my home?
faqs.a: Private water / sewer line insurance is not required by the City of Arvada. City Code section 102.76 states that property owners are responsible for the portion of the service line located on their property. Property owners should make their own decisions regarding insurance needs. Insurance companies may occasionally advertise services to property owners. These companies are not associated with the City of Arvada.
